title: Core additive equivalence for Veronese fractions
statement: For a scheme X, an invertible module L, a natural number d, and a homogeneous section s of degree d, the canonical map from SectionFractionPresentation (L.tensorPow d) (𝟙_ X.Modules) (s.val d) to HomogeneousLocalization.Away (sectionRingGrade L) s.val, sending the class [n, ξ] to the homogeneous fraction ξ / s^n, is bijective. Moreover, for every n and every homogeneous ξ of degree n*d, its value on the section-fraction class of the numerator transported by the tensor-power identification is exactly HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk with numerator ξ and denominator s^n.

source.place: Equation module-invert-s (Tag 0B5L), Lemma 01PW(2), and the Veronese localization in the proof of Lemma 01Q1

proof.text: Define the canonical map as the quotient lift of the explicit direct-sum numerator map. Apply QuotientAddGroup.injective_lift_iff to the kernel equality for injectivity. Apply QuotientAddGroup.lift_surjective_of_surjective to sectionRingVeroneseFractionMap_surjective and the kernel inclusion for surjectivity.

Evaluate the quotient lift on a homogeneous fraction generator by definitional reduction with change. The direct-sum summand formula and sectionRingVeroneseNumerator_cancel cancel the tensor-power identification, yielding the displayed fraction.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0B5L, Lemma 01PW(2), and Lemma 01Q1: kernel-based injectivity and quotient-lift surjectivity from the numerator-map API.

lean.statement:
theorem sectionRing_veronese_fraction_core
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (d : ℕ) (s : sectionRingGrade L d) :
    Function.Bijective
      (sectionRingVeroneseFractionCanonicalMap X L d s) ∧
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (ξ : sectionRingGrade L (n • d)),
      sectionRingVeroneseFractionCanonicalMap X L d s
        (sectionFraction (L.tensorPow d) (𝟙_ X.Modules) (s.val d) n
          ((eqToIso (congrArg L.tensorPow (by simp [Nat.mul_comm])) ≪≫
            L.tensorPowMulIso d n ≪≫ (λ_ _).symm).hom.app ⊤ (ξ.val (n • d)))) =
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (sectionRingGrade L) s.property n
        ξ.val ξ.property
